''See also: [[Galactic Union Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Galactic [[Union]] is the largest interplanetary government in civilized space, serving as one of the four major corners of the galaxy alongside the [[Karoshan Alliance]], the [[Free Worlds]], and [[Dark Space]]. Its territory encompasses human space, the [[Aethril]], and the [[Dornoth system]]. The [[Union]] is characterized by its massive [[scale]], with billions of people connected via the [[Subline]] and a presence marked by extensive ship traffic, colonies, and stations. It is often viewed as a protective force or shield for the innocent against threats like the [[Iron Legion]], though it has also been responsible for instigating a devastating civil war in its pursuit of dominance. The [[Union]]'s headquarters is located in the [[Fathom system]], which also serves as the center for its controlling organization. The government is led by President [[Telappen Vashei]], a human woman. However, the [[Union]] is widely believed to be puppeteered by a [[Shadow|shadow]] organization known as [[Solstice]]. This secret entity operates from the [[Fathom system]] and is thought to manipulate [[Union]] affairs, including engineering chaos to expand influence. The [[Union]] possesses significant military and magical capabilities; it maintains large fleets of gray ships, utilizes [[pathfinding magic|pathfinding spells]], and oversees a massive magical community where millions of mages study to become Tower-certified wizards. While it provides security and intelligence, the [[Union]] has also been known to use its power to suppress dissent, deny entry to its systems, and conduct secret operations.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Galactic [[Union]] is the largest interplanetary government in civilized space, a political entity led by [[Telappen Vashei|President Vashei]] that maintains a generic corporate appearance. This space-faring organization certifies Archmages, operates destroyers and battleships, and utilizes soldiers, operational squads, and investigation teams to enforce its laws. While the [[Union]] has achieved victories in the [[Evven-Fahr system]] and subdued the [[Hive]], it currently faces intense pressure from the [[Iron Legion]] and encroaching [[Hives]]. Despite being controlled by a secret organization, the [[Union]] refuses to bow to threats even as the [[Iron King]] pushes into its territory and the [[Iron Legion]] begins an invasion.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|As one of the four corners of the galaxy, the Galactic [[Union]] is a centralized entity with Fathom at its heart and a President serving as its political leader. Although the organization possesses dreadnoughts and controls space within the [[Thevellian System]] in name only, its vast territories consist of sparsely populated regions marked by rings of gray metal floating in space. While the [[Shadow|shadow]] organization [[Solstice]] maintains control over the [[Union]], its [[Authority|authority]] was challenged when Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Doctor Mell was captured within its borders and students eventually departed its territory. During later conflicts, the [[Union]] permitted a mixed fleet into its space and saw its explosive ships destroyed, even as a battlegroup pushed into the narrator's lines before [[the Advocates]] ultimately decapitated the organization.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Galactic [[Union]] is a hostile entity that maintains military outposts and provides support to [[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]]. Historically, the group performed a takeover that forced splinter factions to flee into [[Dark Space]], and they once assembled a fleet alongside the [[Starhammer]] and [[Karoshan Alliance]] to hunt the narrator. In their pursuit of control, they have used magic to eliminate dissenters and placed bounties on the heads of the narrator and [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]]. During a confrontation, the [[Union]] held up the narrator, though the crew still maintains the ability to inform them of certain developments. Ultimately, the group must be prevented from acquiring [[Zenith]] technology.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Galactic [[Union]] is a group of influential leaders that aims for unity, though the entity is secretly controlled by [[Solstice]] and a criminal organization. While the [[Union]] possesses vast resources, including the [[Magic Tower]] and defense satellites, it is plagued by corruption and an underbelly of contacts. The organization's military forces are available to [[Void Prism]], yet its ships have been seen retreating from enemies and allowing militias to perish. After the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]] declared war, the [[Union]] occupied a former docking hangar and attempted to trap [[The Last Horizon]], an entity with which they have become enemies. Following the assassination of their president by [[Omega]], the [[Union]]'s focus shifted toward the [[Karoshan Alliance]] from its capital, Fathom.}}
